notes.title: The "up to date" update
notes.content: [h3]Bringing the Prologue up to date[/h3][p]The full game has been updated a few times since its 1.0 launch, and  we are bringing all these updates to the Prologue as well! notes.title: V1.0 now available
notes.content:
[h3]V1.0 Full Version[/h3]
The full version of The Last Flame just released in 1.0. The game has received a dozen of updates during its Early Access, and now just received its biggest update ever with the full launch of the game! You can preview the full list of changes here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1830970/view/4443457735847051387?l=english

[h3]Grab the full version at 40% OFF![/h3]
Now is the perfect time to add The Last Flame to you library! The game now has a ton of content, received a lot of polish, and you can also grab a copy at its lowest price ever!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1830970/The_Last_Flame/

[h3]V1.0 Prologue[/h3]
The full version of The Last Flame has received many updates throughout its Early Access period, and we are now bringing some of those updates to the Prologue version as well!

Overall, all updates made during Early Access will be present in the Prologue with the exception of content updates. Here's what the 1.0 update brings to the Prologue:

[list]
[*] 5 New Languages Available (Spanish, Portuguese, Korean, Japanese and Russian)
[*] Recipe Locking system and Soft Ban Automatic System which increases the chance to see items, heroes, relics and origins that you are more likely to be interested in
[*] Improved Combat Recap
[*] Events revamp, 26 out of 27 events have received modifications, balance changes and totally new options
[*] 3 New Events
[*] Hundreds of balance changes.
[*] Improved active description
[*] New resolution for the 16:10 screen aspect ratio
[*] Adjustable keybinds
[*] You can now restart a run after completing it, and abandon a run from the main menu
[*] Performance improvements
[/list]

[previewyoutube=x2BtfXoj9n0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Last Flame (full version) Early Access Release!
notes.content:
[h3]The Last Flame is now officially released in early access![/h3]
Grab the game while it's 10% OFF this week: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1830970/The_Last_Flame/
[h3]Make thousands of different combination and builds with:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 58 Heroes
[*] 300 Items
[*] 60 Origins
[*] 125 Relics
[/list]
[h3]Unlock the full adventure:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Access to all 5 Ascension Difficulties + 1 Challenge Difficulty
[*] Access to all 3 Acts + 1 Final Boss
[*] Access to the Endless Mode which adds an Endless Act to push the limits of your builds
[*] Access to 14 Challenges to completely change how you play the game
[/list]

[b]If you like the game, please make sure to leave a review! It helps tremendously with discoverability on Steam![/b] This is really the best way that you can support a solo dev!


[h3]Early Access[/h3]
The game launches in Early Access which means that it will get constant updates for free until 1.0! 

[previewyoutube=G67Aa_nkCjE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Special Thanks[/h3]
A special thanks to all the beta testers who have been absolutely amazing! I couldn't have made such a great game without your help! From bug reports to feedback to suggestions to typo corrections to being an amazing community and friends that I could talk to about the game or just meme around about phlugee. You gave me the strength to stay extremely motivated, and give my 100% to make The Last Flame into the best possible game! Thank you, thank you so much!

notes.title: 0.6.4 - issues with AMD card fixes, Mech Origin Rework and 6 new music tracks!
notes.content:
The issues that were causing crashes while hovering over a hero ability (with a video) and using specific AMD graphics (generally RX 6700 XT -6900 XT) cards has now been completely fixed.

The Mech Origin has been reworked.

The game now has 6 new and improved music tracks. Act 1 (2 new tracks), Act 3 (2 new tracks), elite fight and boss fight's music tracks have been updated!

notes.title: Speed Run Contest - Prologue - Vasfen Kill
notes.content:
[b]Prizes to be won, tons of fun, join our community on discord for more information! 
[/b]https://discord.gg/dvbj7bEgxW  -> Channel: #speedrun-rules

[h3]Prizes[/h3]
🥇 1 TLF game key + 20$ USD Steam Gift Card  + named item (rename a current item OR name a future item from multiple choices of item, this will be added whenever there's a future content patch)
🥈 1 TLF game key + 20$ USD Steam Gift Card
🥉 1 TLF game key

[h3]Rules[/h3]
[list][*] Fight Speed set to 2/3 the entire run. 
[*] No use of unintended mechanics. No cheating.
[*] Run must be a win, and it has to be a Vasfen Kill (Adept on the Prologue).
[*] Record and upload the full run to Youtube or Streamed on Twitch. 720p 30 fps minimum, but 1080p recommended. More information and resources on our discord!
[*] Join our discord, and post your build in the #speedrun-contest channel. [/list]

[h3]Duration[/h3]
From now to January 16th, 10PM EST.

notes.title: The Prologue is now released
notes.content:
[h2]The Prologue is now available, and it is totally free![/h2]
You'll be able to get a glimpse of what The Last Flame has in store! The full game releases on January 17th, so you won't have to turn your thumbs to long before you will be able to play the complete version!

[h2]Vasfen, the exclusive Boss has been unlocked![/h2]
We reached our goal of 6,500 wishlists .... actually we doubled our wishlists goal! We are now at over 14,000 wishlists for the Prologue! Thank you for your amazing help and support! Vasfen will be a very challenging final boss that will give you an opportunity to test the limits of your builds. He is only available in the second difficulty of the Prologue (Adept), so you will have to progress through the first difficulty (Novice) first. Will you be able to defeat him?

[h2]Wishlist the full game:[/h2]

notes.title: The Prologue launches on January 8th!
notes.content:
Exciting news! I am very pleased to announce that the Prologue will launch on January 8th! Yes, that's right! You will be able to play the Prologue in less than 2 weeks! The Early Access launch will also be announced very very soon, so stay tuned for that!

[h2]Wishlist the Prologue![/h2]
It would mean a lot, if you can help us reach our wishlist goal for the Prologue. We are extremely close, and every wishlist helps tremendously! As I have announced in the past, if we reach our goal of 6,500, an [b]EXCLUSIVE FINAL BOSS[/b] will be available to challenge your best builds in the Prologue!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160826/501bf9dc9e956d39573da71cbcc9eb7914d856b9.png[/img]
[b]I am incredibly grateful for your support and enthusiasm! The community has been amazing for the game, and kept me extremely motivated throughout its development! Thank you for being a part of The Last Flame's journey, and helping it reach new heights![/b]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2517810/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160826/21ed57f0ac5bee4d26ee75c4b73d8e7d96aa7cf8.png[/img]
[h2]What's the Prologue all about?[/h2]
The prologue is a free version of The Last Flame that allows you to dive into the game before its early access!
If you played the Demo, here's what is new in the Prologue, and if you are new, I would highly recommend checking out the Prologue when it releases as it will give you a great overview of what to expect of the full game!

The Prologue will feature 2 new bosses, 1 new difficulty, 20% more content in the form of items, heroes, origins and relics, and of course the Final Boss if we manage to reach the 6,500 wishlists goal!
